'Christmas Candles' (candles-home-fragrance, 46), 'Christmas Tablewear' [site's own spelling] (christmas-tableware-party, 34) and 'Christmas Stockings' (1) are standalone Home leaves. 'Party & occasions' (64 results: greetings cards/invitations/party decorations/gift wrap) is a generic year-round occasions category, not tied to any specific holiday, excluded per rule S5/S6. Halloween: canonical /GB/en/cat/halloween/ (43 results total: Kids 24, Foodhall 15, Home & Tech 4) is a genuine merchandised category (editorial copy, breadcrumb, facets) but is cross-department as a whole; only its Home & Tech facet child (own URL /halloween/home-tech/, own H1, 4 results, content-verified: Disney-branded Halloween mugs/pumpkin decor) is in scope. No parent grouping row added (parent is mostly non-Home). Eid: canonical /GB/en/cat/gifts/eid/ (155 results: Beauty/Foodhall/Womens/Bags/Jewellery/Mens) has no Home & Tech facet at all -- no Home row. Diwali, Thanksgiving, New Year (tried new-year, new-years-eve): all searches resolved to the generic /GB/en/cat/ search-root canonical, i.e. no dedicated merchandised category exists for these on this site -- correctly absent, not a false-negative search (confirmed via canonical-URL check, not a raw zero-count read). Mother's Day and Father's Day were explicitly content-verified per task instruction, not included on H1/URL alone: 'Mother's Day Home & Tech Gifts' (/gifts/mothers-day/home-tech/, 34 results) is itself 100% Home (its own Home facet = 34/34, no Technology split), content sampled = candles, coffee makers, ceramics, home accessories -- genuine Home products, included as-is. 'Father's Day' gift hub's Home & Tech facet (45 results) splits into Home(35)/Technology(9)/Christmas shop(1 cross-tag); used the narrower Home-only child (/gifts/fathers-day/home-tech/home/, 35 results, content sampled = espresso machine, pizza oven, cooler box, dining/kitchen items) to stay Home-scoped and exclude Technology gadgets. Valentine's Day gift hub 'Valentine's Day Candles, Home & Tech Gifts' (/gifts/valentines-day/home-tech/, 58 results) splits Home(53)/Technology(5); used the narrower Home-only child (/gifts/valentines-day/home-tech/home/, 53 results, content sampled = candles, ceramics, coffee/matcha sets) for the same reason. All qty values are the site's own 'N results' / 'N/N results' rendered PLP header text, read after Playwright network-idle-ish wait (domcontentloaded + 6s settle); none estimated or summed. No PDPs were opened; classification used H1/breadcrumb/description/facet copy and product-title sampling only where a page's Home-scope was ambiguous (Seasonal home overlap, Father's/Mother's/Valentine's Home & Tech facets, Halloween Home & Tech facet).
